title: Forward to the past: Short-term effects of the rent freeze in Berlin (DIW DP 1928; Management Science 2024)
key_point: Mietendeckel cut advertised rents 7-11%, shrank listings, pushed rents up in Potsdam; ~50% compliance; Berlin ownership 17.4%.

title: Mietpreisbremse ist besser als ihr Ruf, aber nicht die Loesung des Wohnungsmarktproblems
key_point: Rent brake only bites where new-lease rents grew >3.9%/yr; dampens growth but cannot cure scarcity.

title: CBRE-Berlin Hyp Housing Market Report Berlin 2026
key_point: Asking rent EUR15.80/m2, new build 20.73, subsidised 7.06; condos EUR5,813/m2; only 12.7% of pipeline inside S-Bahn ring.

title: Kwartaalcijfers Q1 2026
key_point: 71% of Amsterdam purchases above asking; supply up as landlords sell rental stock; longer time on market.

title: Homegate-Mietindex Oktober 2025 press release
publisher: SMG Swiss Marketplace Group / Homegate with ZKB
key_point: Hedonic asking-rent index: +3.1% y/y, +15.6% in 10 yrs; reference for pricing rentals; ZKB sees 47k new flats 2026.

title: Der Berliner Immobilienmarkt nimmt 2024 wieder Fahrt auf
key_point: 20,789 notarised sales 2024; condos EUR5,251/m2, new build 7,912; land values cut 5% for houses.

title: Ad hoc Marktreport Dezember 2024 - Bauland individueller Wohnungsbau
key_point: Plots sold at 87% of Bodenrichtwert (n=84); analysis by district and four-tier Wohnlage from automated price collection.

title: Neuer Mietspiegel liegt vor
key_point: Qualified Mietspiegel 2024 from ~16,000 flats; median EUR7.21/m2; cells by Wohnlage, Baualter, Ausstattung.

title: In hoeverre telt de WOZ-waarde mee bij de puntentelling van mijn woning?
key_point: WOZ counts fully up to 186 points, one-third above, to stop high city values inflating regulated rents.

title: Leerwohnungsziffer faellt unter 0,5 Prozent
key_point: Canton vacancy 0.48% (20-yr low), city of Zurich 0.10%; four-room flats tightest at 0.44%.

title: Koep av bostadsraett med laag/hoeg insats vs hoeg/laag avgift?
key_point: Monthly avgift capitalises into price; compare total cost, beware developer low-deposit high-fee structures.

title: Koepa vaar foersta laegenhet (STAMBYTE?!)
key_point: Buyers judge association debt/m2, savings/m2, stambyte timing, HSB management; couple bought below asking in cool market.

title: Bostadskoep: Hur bestaemmer ni ert maximala pris/bud-tak?
key_point: Max bid from Booli valuation, same-building final prices, monthly-cost budget; balcony, floor, kitchen drive premiums.

title: Strategi vid budgivning
key_point: Open agent-run bidding: bid early, signal seriousness, small increments; over half of homes sold without bidding wars.

title: Average wait time for Stockholm first-hand rentals over 28 years long
key_point: Survey of 200 housing firms: Stockholm county wait 337 months vs 79 in Skane; readers dispute figure.

title: 82 percent of homes sold in 2025 were advertised on Hemnet
key_point: Hemnet carried 139,063 of 170,415 Swedish sales in 2025 (82%), down from 86-90% in 2019-24.

title: Stockholms bostadsmarknad svalnar men raett laegenhet kostar fortfarande miljoner
key_point: Stockholm co-ops ~SEK97,000/m2; bidding less intense; Sodermalm 1-bed SEK4m+ vs half in outer areas; rates key.

title: Bostadsmarknad Stockholm
key_point: Queue 15-20 yrs inner city, 5-10 outer; sublets 50-100% above utility-value rents; ~750k queued.

title: Rent Increases in Berlin: Rent Control, Cap Limits, and the Rent Index
key_point: Mietpreisbremse: Mietspiegel +10% to 2029; post-Oct-2014 new builds exempt; 15%/3yr cap in Berlin.

title: Pressemitteilung Nr. 25/26 - Mietspiegel 2026
key_point: Mietspiegel 2026 average EUR7.71/m2 (+6.9%); upper values up to 27.84 driven by post-2014 and temporary lets.

title: Bewertungsverfahren bei Immobilien: Ertragswert, Vergleichswert, Sachwert
key_point: Comparison method for condos/houses; income method via Liegenschaftszins for rentals; cost method with Sachwertfaktor otherwise.

title: 12.5% of Dutch home sellers lower asking price, EUR41,551 on average
key_point: Price cuts taint listings: reduced homes get +3.2% overbids vs +4.8%; a third sell below reduced price.

title: Amsterdamse huizenprijzen dalen harder dan landelijk, maar overbieden blijft de norm
key_point: Q1 2026: Noord 86% above asking, Centrum 58% (+2%), West +7.7%; avg price -5.8% but per-m2 only -1.3%.

title: Buyers beware: overbidding is back, mainly for cheaper homes
key_point: Q2 2024: 66% above asking, +4.1%; Utrecht +11.2%, Amsterdam +9.3%; EUR1m+ homes sometimes below asking.

title: Overbidding takes place in two-thirds of house sales in the Netherlands
key_point: High energy-label homes attract more overbidding; overbidding less frequent above EUR1m.

title: Locals overbid by more than internationals when buying Dutch home
key_point: Internationals overbid more often (77% vs 70%) but less (7.6% vs 9.3%), attributed to buyer's agents.

title: How to calculate a winning offer for your Dutch dream house
key_point: Bids built from appraisal, WOZ value, Kadaster comparables, condition, energy label; homes sell in ~27 days.

title: Tenants overbidding by up to EUR300 a month for scarce city homes
key_point: Amsterdam renters bid EUR50-300/month over asking rent; advertised rent has become a starting price.

title: Home hunting horrors: relocating to Zurich and what we wish we knew
key_point: Zurich landlords minimise risk, favour stable locals; allow 6+ months; CHF ~2,200 for 3.5 rooms.

title: Apartment hunting tips: Reddit's guide for Germany
key_point: Reddit-derived German rental dossier: ID, SCHUFA, income proof, self-disclosure, landlord references; warm vs cold rent.

title: How many apartments did you apply? - English Forum Switzerland
key_point: Snippet: Zurich flats draw 40-60 applicants; posters applied to 12-20+ flats over months.

title: How the WBS certificate works? - Toytown Germany
key_point: Snippet: WBS is permission to apply for subsidised flats, not a payment; obtained at Buergeramt.
